title: Topic 37 | Ideal gas. Basic equation of the gas MKT. Dalton's law

questions.text: What must be neglected for a gas to be considered ideal?
answers: interaction of its molecules during collisions
interaction of its molecules at a distance

questions.text: On which of the following statements is the expression v_x² = 1/3 v² based?
answers: the number of molecules is small
molecules collide elastically with each other
